description: This file defines the LanguageDao class responsible for data access operations related to Language entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting language records, as well as checking the existence of a language name.

classes.name: LanguageDao
classes.description: A data access object responsible for performing database operations related to Language entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Persists a Language entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of existing language IDs matching the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of Language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a Paginator object for paginated retrieval of Language entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Language entities matching given search filters.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language name already exists in the database.
